verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API for programmatic access to meeting notes and an official MCP server for connecting AI tools like Claude/ChatGPT, which supports agentic/AI-native building. However, there is no evidence of dedicated language SDKs (Python/JS client libraries) — a probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s, suggesting the API is documented only via raw REST endpoints rather than packaged SDKs. Missing for 10: official client SDK packages (Python/JS/etc.), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent developer corroboration of building against it.
